remarks: Spring special! Incredible value: WOW! Super spacious & elegant 2 bed apartment on the second floor (stairs) of a historic colonial conveniently located close to exit 16 of I95. Walk to Norwalk Green, Town Hall, 2 minute drive to Stew Leonards! Fabulous high ceilings, plus period features including decorative fireplaces and exposed brick! Hardwood floors in living room and office. Sizable eat-in kitchen has ceramic tile floor. In-unit stackable washer dryer. Half bath. Two well apportioned bedrooms with their own private bathrooms complete the picture of this gem! 675+ credit score plus minimum collective earnings of $8,000 a month. No pets, no smoking... No exceptions! Great landlord who works and resides on floor 1! Schedule your tour today!
